title: Peter S NDE 7011
content: Before the first event, I complained of being very tired and sleepy. I was at that time, April 1991, working at the Operating Room in a hospital. At a certain moment, the professor looked at me and said, 'Peter, you look so white'. I answered him: 'Yes, prof, I am just very, very tired'. He told me, to go to the coffee room off the operating room, drink a coffee, and come back. These were the last words. I never, in my entire life, fell asleep as nicely as during that time. I felt no weight, was going wherever I wanted and there were beautiful white clouds of which I'd never seen. The feeling was amazing; it looked like freedom. Then at a certain moment, I saw a face and a body in very nice white clothes, a fresh face with black half-short hair, which started talking to me. I don't know if it is male or female, but it very friendly. This person told me, 'You have to go back, because you need to do a lot for the people, it is not yet time to come here.' Then I immediately turned around, and I wake up on an Intensive Care Unit bed with all IV's, Electro Cardio Gram machines and a number of doctors around me who said, 'Welcome back, Peter, we thought we had lost you. You were gone for 20 minutes.' The first thing I did was to feel my body. It was very strange to have a body, which I had never experienced before the happening. Since that time, I know there is no death. Because of my job flying an average over 350 flights a year, I am totally not afraid of death. I feel the person I saw, was one of the masters who guide our planet Earth. My second experience was just recently. As my wife and I went to bed, I told her, 'my heart is beating not in the way it should'. (Note: I had 6 cardio bypass surgeries in 2009 and was under the care of a Cardiologist.) As my study is in the medical realm, I do understand what was going happening. I told my wife, that if I did not wake up, she knows what to do. My heart kept going strange but I fell asleep. This time, it was different. When I woke up, the next day, in the afternoon, my wife was still sitting next to me and told me I did not react to anything and she was at the point of calling my colleagues: a few doctors. When I woke up, I remember that I saw a violet fire from my heart. Inside was a grey door, which I went through. I saw a kind of a small tunnel with a very intense strong white light where there was another door, as well. I opened it, and came into a place that was so beautiful: I had never seen such beauty! The mountains, the kind of trees, flowers, so fine from their structure to the colors: 'I never saw these colors before and cannot express it'. The small river with such clear fine water, I'd never, ever seen in my life. Then, I was in a car with three people, who were a bit bigger than we are. Again, I had never seen the car before, not even in Sci-Fi movies. The form and colors, again, I'd never seen and can't express. We parked the car, they left the doors unlocked, and windows open. I asked, 'You don't close it?' Whereas they said, 'Peter here we don't need this', they laughed kindly. We then crossed the road and entered into a hotel or building, again, the structure, form, beautiful wood, with a structure I can't explain that was so fine and precise. After a while, they told me they had to go and I should go back, because they said, 'You, also, still need to accomplish your mission'. I returned through the same way from which I came. After telling this to my wife, she was astonished. I also discussed it with some friends who are closer to the other world than me, and they stated: 'it is you were in another world, out of your body'. The same day I checked my heart by Electro Cardio Gram, and they found rare things, which they cannot explain until now. This was last May, 2013.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Second experience: after seeing a violet fire from his heart, he went through a grey door into 'a kind of a small tunnel with a very intense strong white light' and another door.

arrival.other_being_detail: First experience: a friendly person with 'very nice white clothes' and black half-short hair. Second experience: three people 'a bit bigger than we are'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Mountains; trees and flowers with unprecedented structure and colors; a small river with very clear water; unfamiliar car; hotel/building with beautiful wood and fine, precise structure; beautiful white clouds (first experience).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told twice to go back because he 'need[s] to do a lot for the people' / 'still need[s] to accomplish your mission.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: First event: sudden collapse/unresponsiveness at work (operating room) with reported absence for 20 minutes. Second event: suspected cardiac arrhythmia during sleep (history of cardiac bypass surgeries).

person_demographics.occupation: Worked in a hospital operating room; later reports frequent flying (average 350 flights/year).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Second experience included violet fire from the heart and passing through doors; travel in an unfamiliar car with three beings; entering a hotel/building.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First experience emphasized cloud-like freedom and encounter with a friendly figure before immediate return. Second experience included doors/violet fire before a tunnel/light, then a detailed landscape and interactions before returning the same way.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two separate NDE-like events (1991 and 2013) with similar 'told to go back' mission message.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Second experience: 'violet fire from my heart' containing a grey door; unfamiliar car and architecture with colors/forms 'not even in Sci-Fi movies'; beings leaving car unlocked and saying security isn't needed there.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You have to go back, because you need to do a lot for the people, it is not yet time to come here.'; 'You, also, still need to accomplish your mission'; 'I never saw these colors before and cannot express it'; 'Welcome back, Peter, we thought we had lost you. You were gone for 20 minutes.'
